events.title: Dog car seat cover is a lower-regulation challenger
events.detail: The category remains active and has a strong dirt/hair before-after demo without electrical compliance, but fit and waterproofing returns need validation.

events.title: Dog car cover price band passes
events.detail: Current mainstream references leave room for a differentiated mid-market offer if landed cost is low enough.

events.title: Packing cubes pass price fit but competition is heavy
events.detail: Current branded references cluster around the target band, but generic saturation means supplier economics and positioning must be exceptional.

events.title: Windshield sunshade passes price/demo filters with seasonality risk
events.detail: Current listings fit the target band, but universal-fit complaints and seasonality are material risks.

events.title: Leader retained; three challengers strengthened
events.detail: Kit Muda Cero remains first; dog car seat cover moves to WATCH; packing cubes and windshield sunshade enter the top five pending supplier economics.

events.title: Product discovery cycle complete
events.detail: Top candidates and handoffs updated.

events.title: Starting customer-voice mining cycle
events.detail: Mining objections and return drivers for the current leader and top challengers.

events.title: Kit Muda Cero promise is too broad
events.detail: Slicker suitability varies by coat and technique and reusable rollers have surface limitations; the offer should explain which tool is for which coat or textile.

events.title: Dog-car-cover return risks concentrated in fit and durability
events.detail: Vehicle fit, clips, zippers, waterproof backing and sliding are the main quality risks to gate at sourcing.

events.title: Sunshade convenience wins, fit and handle durability lose
events.detail: Compact fast deployment is the desired outcome; sizing and structural durability are the key objections.

events.title: Tighten Kit Muda Cero positioning
events.detail: Recommend a coat and surface specific 3-step routine and remove universal-surface implications from copy.

events.title: Customer Voice cycle complete
events.detail: Five high-impact insights persisted and handed off.

events.title: Starting multi-SKU offer cycle
events.detail: Synthesizing current product, customer voice, supplier and competitor handoffs into a coherent catalogue structure.

events.title: Three job-led collections selected
events.detail: Portfolio organized as Mascotas en casa, Mascotas en movimiento, and Viaje y coche.

events.title: Muda Cero price-test order raised
events.detail: Test 39.90 EUR first, then 34.90 EUR; 29.90 EUR remains acquisition-only pending Finance.

events.title: Second HERO narrowed
events.detail: Only a differentiated hard-bottom or backseat-extender cover should advance as second HERO candidate.

events.title: Merchandising map v1 created
events.detail: Roles, collections, price tests, creative direction and downstream handoffs are defined.

events.title: Creative & Offer cycle complete
events.detail: Material catalogue architecture and pricing changes persisted for downstream agents.

events.title: Running finance gate
events.detail: Using verified component costs and current competitor price bands; unknown costs remain explicit.

events.title: 39.90 EUR is finance-preferred Muda Cero test
events.detail: At a 50% pre-ad contribution target on ex-VAT revenue, total non-ad variable costs must stay <=16.49 EUR/order; 8.49 EUR headroom remains after the two verified components.

events.title: 29.90 EUR is too tight for default paid acquisition
events.detail: At the same 50% target, only 4.36 EUR remains for roller + shipping + fees + returns after the two verified components.

events.title: Finance gate complete
events.detail: Kit Muda Cero remains WATCH leaning GO at 39.90 EUR pending full non-ad variable-cost verification.

events.title: Multiproduct storefront architecture advanced
events.detail: Main non-commercial preview updated with three job-led collection entries, reusable PDP validation states and corrected catalogue mapping; 14/15 static checks pass.
